added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

0.reason: the region change follows the lead ruling c-s21-owner-lobe-ruling (2026-10-17), given in resume advice after the node measured the half-plane region 19% too large at 2,098; the review read the original brief only

1.reason: corrected by the coordinator at merge: the record states the lobe against the half-plane bar as well (worse at 282 by 6.5e-6 and at 550, 4.87e-4 against 4.10e-4; better at 2,098), beside the guards

3.reason: manifest-only omission; the coordinator audited the diff and region_audit.py lies inside the declared write path

findings.text: blocking: the dispatched goal and the lead's 2026-10-17 ruling direct the node to keep the half-plane owner region and repair how current is integrated over it, but the node retires the half-plane and makes the normal-form lobe the owner region; its own measurement (the submitted region 18.99% too large at 2,098) is a substantive refutation of the ruling's "area is already right" premise, yet changing the region is a deviation from the dispatched spec rather than the integration repair it names, and it is a deviation the lead must adjudicate before the goal can be called met.

blocking: the clause-2 verdict reads "met at 550 and 2,098, missed at 282 by 1.4e-9" by comparing the lobe against the guards 1.0866e-3/5.0e-4/1.0e-4, whereas clause 2 as dispatched compares 282 and 550 against the half-plane's own errors 1.08006e-3 and 4.09606e-4; on the clause's own bar 550 is also missed (4.87161187281e-4 > 4.09606e-4) and 282 is missed by 6.5e-6 rather than 1.4e-9, so the table overstates the clause's outcome at two of three carriers.

follow-on: _fan_moments duplicates the signed-ring current-moment reduction the repository already owns at nova/equilibrium/clip_quadrature.py:716 (clipped_support_current_moments, whose _quadrature_from_arrays(..., signed=True) at :378 is the same signed fan) rather than extending or wrapping that owner, so a later correction to the owner's rule will not reach the lobe booking; only the reduction is duplicated, since the ring geometry is taken from current._normal_rings at four sites.
follow-on: changed_paths lists 14 files and omits scripts/prototypes/xpoint_cell_owner/region_audit.py, which git diff --name-only 6c29276c4 e05e47dc0 lists among the 15 changed files.

follow-on: remaining_moments and _cell_rings reconstruct the cell polygon fan from geometry.vertices and geometry.vertex_count instead of taking it from the same current._normal_rings call that builds the lobe, and the committed partition is knowingly defective — at 2,098 the dense cell carries 27.47 A against 0.7845 A in the lobe and -1.154 A for lobe plus remainder — so a remainder path reported as unestablished is committed in that state.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit from 6c29276c4 to e05e47dc0; a new lobe_booking module books the normal-form lobe and its remainder with one degree-five signed-fan rule, lobe_reference and lobe_reference_probe supply an independent closed-form reference and its comparison, region_audit/region_density/region_reference add the audit, dense-profile and per-node reference probes, device_owner's integrate_cell gains density_mode/profile/span with a cancellation-free root path and _INNER_WEIGHTS, owner_map gains the "lobe" component branch and threads density_mode, owner_attribution/panel_data/root_checks/runtime_solve/solve_carrier thread it through, and the research doc and evidence fragment are added; four assertions are added, all jax_enable_x64 or default_backend environment guards, and none compares a value against the same variable the script passed in.
item_verdicts.done_when: clause 2 names 2,098 under 1e-4 with 282 and 550 no worse than the half-plane's own 1.08006e-3 and 4.09606e-4; the lobe books 9.47260772731e-5 (under) and 550 at 4.87161187281e-4, but 550 sits above the 4.09606e-4 bar and 282 at 1.0866014244493266e-3 sits above the 1.08006e-3 bar, so clause 2 is met at one of the three carriers rather than the two the node's table reports; clause 3 reaches 1.4236135421233083e-11 at 2,098 against its 1e-12 criterion and is recorded not met; clauses 4 and 5 (the transition bracket and the poloidal contour panels) are not started and are declared so.
item_verdicts.goal: the dispatched goal is to repair the booked current over the half-plane owner region so the diverted map passes at 2,098 cells, under the lead's 2026-10-17 ruling to keep the half-plane geometry and fix how current is integrated over the owner region; the node reaches the 2,098 target at 9.47260772731e-5 under the 1e-4 guard, but it does so by retiring the half-plane and substituting the normal-form lobe as the owner region (docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/owner-cell-current.html:14), so the named carrier is met on a region the ruling directed it to keep, and by the clause's own bar the substitute is worse at two of the three carriers.
item_verdicts.manifest: read manifest.md; status complete with an in-flight interval's wait_condition and resume_brief left in place, landing "none", 19 commits 5f7f084fe..e05e47dc0, tests and test_logs empty, baseline_suite and after_suite empty, and changed_paths listing 14 of the 15 changed files; the record is candid about every shortfall (the partition unestablished, the 550 Newton stall, the open 282 residual disagreement) and names a negative-control pointer rather than a control.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the four declared paths are scripts/prototypes/xpoint_cell_owner, docs/research/owner-cell-current.html, docs/figures/converged-forward-solve/owner-cell-current and docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/owner-cell-current.html; git diff --name-only 6c29276c43750bfcbfad12647c81998de7208c23 e05e47dc0ffda6470e48471afbd6cadbd333a04b lists 15 files and every one of the 15 lies inside them, with no nova/ and no tests/ change.

justifications.durability: no test imports xpoint_cell_owner (grep over tests/ returns nothing), no test file is changed, and the manifest records tests and test_logs empty with no baseline_suite or after_suite arm, so a regression in the lobe booking or the remainder partition reddens nothing; the one committed partition path is additionally in a state the node reports as unestablished.
justifications.evidence: the map errors, the cold-solve residual histories and the partition are measured in named receipts and SLURM logs and quoted with their terminal verdicts, and the node builds an independent closed-form lobe reference whose 4.8e-10 agreement it correctly attributes to the degree-five constants' ten-digit truncation, but the partition is scored against a construction the node itself reports as defective, the 282 residual disagreement is left open, and every measurement is a runner print rather than a check that could fail.
justifications.fit: the new modules follow the surrounding argparse/jnp prototype idiom and name by mechanism (lobe_booking._fan_moments, _density_of, lobe_moments, remaining_moments, lobe_reference.triangle_integral) with no plan, sprint, milestone, ticket or gate-ID labels in symbols, filenames or comments.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the dispatched carrier is met (2,098 at 9.47260772731e-5 under 1e-4) but by retiring the half-plane owner region the ruling directed the node to keep and substituting the normal-form lobe, and the substitute is worse than the half-plane it replaced at 282 (1.0866014244493266e-3 against 1.08006e-3) and at 550 (4.87161187281e-4 against 4.09606e-4), so the goal is met on a changed region rather than by the repair asked for.
justifications.reuse: lobe_booking._fan_moments (lobe_booking.py:50) builds a signed-ring fan current-moment reduction from scratch rather than extending the owner of that capability, nova/equilibrium/clip_quadrature.py:716 clipped_support_current_moments with _quadrature_from_arrays(..., signed=True) at :378, so an added definition re-implements a capability the repository already owns without extending the owner; the node does reuse current._normal_rings for the ring geometry at four sites, which is why the score is not zero.
justifications.scope_discipline: all 15 files in git diff --name-only 6c29276c4 e05e47dc0 lie inside the four declared write paths, with no nova/equilibrium or nova/biot change, no tests/ change, and no edit outside scripts/prototypes/xpoint_cell_owner and docs.
